title: The Holy Spirit
subtitle: Who he is, how he moves, what he does in us, the gifts he gives, and the fruit he grows
summary: "When the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth" (John 16:13). The Spirit hovers over the waters at creation, rushes on judges and kings, fills craftsmen and prophets, rests on Jesus, and is poured out at Pentecost on sons and daughters alike. He is not a force but a person who speaks, teaches, grieves and prays, and he is God himself. This study follows who he is, the many ways he moves (the Patterns chart counts how he came and what followed), what he does in those he lives in, the gifts he gives, and the fruit he grows. Every list of gifts in the New Testament sits inside a call to love, and the gifts view follows how Scripture ties each gift to the fruit it must be used with.
